REQUEST CONTRACT

Classifier payload

{
  "state": { "event": "<scraped event record>", "persona": "founder_raising" },
  "model": "Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B",
  "questions": {
    "primary_signal": { "type": "choice", "criteria": { "investor_access": "…", "engineer_talent": "…", "research_talent": "…", "job_seeker_fit": "…", "sales_noise": "…" } },
    "worth_attending": { "type": "score", "criteria": ["Skip", "Weak", "Maybe", "Strong", "Must go"] }
  }
}

VERDICT LOGIC

Calendar threshold

Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
GO

Overall utility ≥ 72 and sales-noise probability < 0.55.

MAYBE

Utility 55–71. Route to human review.

SKIP

Utility < 55, or sales-noise probability ≥ 0.70 without a strong audience-specific reason.
